title: Real bank fraud alert (legitimate)
note: Scripted example of how a real bank alert usually sounds.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Hello, this is the fraud prevention team at your bank, calling about your card.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: We noticed an unusual payment of 240 euros at an online store.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: No problem. Please never share a code with anyone, we will never ask you for one.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: You can block the payment yourself in your banking app, or call the number on the back of your card.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: No action is needed on this call. Have a good day.
